prompt.label: Medium — Contract and Document Analysis
prompt.userMessage: Our procurement and legal teams review hundreds of vendor agreements every quarter, and identifying unusual clauses or inconsistent commercial terms has become increasingly difficult. Important obligations around renewals, pricing adjustments, or compliance requirements are often buried deep within lengthy documents. The current review process is heavily manual and depends on institutional knowledge from a small number of experienced employees. We are looking for a more scalable way to analyze large volumes of business documents and surface key risks or inconsistencies earlier in the process.

rounds.content:
{
  "action": "clarify",
  "round": 1,
  "message": "This could go a few directions. Which is closest to what you want?

A) Contract review queue — uploaded agreements get AI-analyzed, flagged clauses appear in a reviewer worklist with severity + citations
B) Clause search & comparison tool — reviewers ask plain-English questions across all agreements and get cited answers (e.g. 'show me all auto-renewal clauses over 2 years')
C) Risk dashboard — executives see trends across the contract portfolio (unusual terms by vendor, renewal calendar, pricing outliers)
D) Contract intake workflow — track each agreement through procurement → legal → signoff with checklists and approvals"
}

          {"name": "category", "type": "VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL"},
          {"name": "rationale", "type": "TEXT NOT NULL"},

          {"name": "user_id", "type": "INTEGER REFERENCES users(id)"},

    "endpoints": [
      {"method": "GET", "path": "/whoami", "response": {"status": 200, "body": "{ id, email, role }"}},
      {"method": "GET", "path": "/vendors", "response": {"status": 200, "body": "[{ id, name }]"}},
      {"method": "POST", "path": "/vendors", "request": {"name": "string required"}, "response": {"status": 201, "body": "{ id, name }"}},
      {"method": "POST", "path": "/agreements", "request": {"file": "multipart file required (PDF/doc, memory-only)", "vendor_id": "integer required", "title": "string optional"}, "response": {"status": 201, "body": "{ id, vendor_id, filename, title, status, flag_count }"}},
      {"method": "GET", "path": "/agreements", "request": {"limit": "integer default 50", "offset": "integer default 0", "vendor_id": "integer optional"}, "response": {"status": 200, "body": "{ items: [{ id, vendor_id, vendor_name, filename, title, status, flag_count, created_at }], total }"}},
      {"method": "GET", "path": "/agreements/:id", "response": {"status": 200, "body": "{ id, vendor_id, vendor_name, filename, title, full_text, status, created_at }"}},
      {"method": "GET", "path": "/flags", "request": {"limit": "integer default 50", "offset": "integer default 0", "severity": "string optional", "status": "string optional", "assigned_to": "integer optional"}, "response": {"status": 200, "body": "{ items: [{ id, severity, category, status, rationale, clause_text, citation_start, citation_end, page_hint, agreement_id, vendor_name, created_at }], total }"}},
      {"method": "GET", "path": "/flags/:id", "response": {"status": 200, "body": "{ id, severity, category, rationale, status, clause: { id, text, citation_start, citation_end, page_hint }, agreement: { id, title, vendor_name } }"}},
      {"method": "PATCH", "path": "/flags/:id", "request": {"status": "string required (resolved|escalated|accepted)"}, "response": {"status": 200, "body": "{ id, status, resolved_by, resolved_at }"}},
      {"method": "GET", "path": "/flags/export", "request": {"severity": "string optional", "status": "string optional"}, "response": {"status": 200, "body": "text/csv stream"}},
      {"method": "GET", "path": "/admin/stats", "response": {"status": 200, "body": "{ flag_trends: [{ date, count }], reviewer_workload: [{ user_id, email, open_flags }], vendor_stats: [{ vendor_id, vendor_name, total_flags, high_severity }] }"}},
      {"method": "GET", "path": "/audit-log", "request": {"limit": "integer default 50", "offset": "integer default 0"}, "response": {"status": 200, "body": "{ items: [{ id, user_email, action, entity_type, entity_id, details, created_at }], total }"}}
    ]

  "ui_contract": {
    "primary_view": "reviewer worklist of flagged clauses",
    "primary_action": "open a flag and resolve, escalate, or accept it",
    "secondary_views": ["upload agreement", "agreement detail with cited clauses", "flag detail with source citation", "admin dashboard", "audit log"],
    "components": [
      {"name": "WorklistTable", "role": "ranked list of open flags with severity badges and vendor/agreement context"},
      {"name": "SeverityBadge", "role": "color-coded severity indicator (high/medium/low)"},
      {"name": "FlagDetailPanel", "role": "shows cited clause text, rationale, and resolve/escalate/accept actions"},
      {"name": "CitationViewer", "role": "renders clause excerpt with source location/offset hint"},
      {"name": "AgreementUploader", "role": "multipart file upload with vendor selector and progress indicator during AI analysis"},
      {"name": "AgreementList", "role": "browse uploaded agreements with flag counts"},
      {"name": "AgreementDetail", "role": "shows agreement metadata and all extracted clauses + flags"},
      {"name": "AdminDashboard", "role": "flag trends chart, reviewer workload table, vendor stats"},
      {"name": "AuditLogView", "role": "chronological list of review actions"},
      {"name": "CsvExportButton", "role": "downloads filtered flags as CSV"}
    ]
  },
  "business_logic_contract": {
    "triggers": [
      {"event": "user_first_login", "action": "create users row from OIDC claims (sub, email), default role='reviewer'"},
      {"event": "agreement_uploaded", "action": "parse text from in-memory file, call MGA to classify clauses with severity + citation offsets, persist agreement + clauses + flags in Postgres, embed clauses into pgvector — all before responding (file is not retained on disk)"},
      {"event": "high_severity_flag_created", "action": "send email notification via MGA email tool to reviewers"},
      {"event": "flag_status_changed", "action": "set resolved_by + resolved_at, write audit_log row"},
      {"event": "csv_export_requested", "action": "stream filtered flags joined with clause/agreement/vendor as CSV, write audit_log row"}
    ],
    "rules": [
      "all authenticated users (reviewers + admins) can view and act on any flag (shared worklist)",
      "/admin/* endpoints require role='admin'",
      "/audit-log requires role='admin'",
      "only the original uploader or an admin can delete an agreement",
      "flag status must be one of: open, resolved, escalated, accepted",
      "severity must be one of: high, medium, low",
      "uploaded files are processed in memory only and never written to disk"
    ],
    "side_effects": [
      "audit log row written on every upload, flag status change, and CSV export",
      "email notification sent on high-severity flag creation",
      "pgvector embeddings upserted on agreement upload"
    ]
  },
  "vector_engine": "pgvector",
  "mga_assistants": [
    {
      "key": "default",
      "name": "Contract Clause Analyzer",
      "description": "Analyzes uploaded vendor agreement text, extracts unusual clauses, renewal terms, pricing adjustments, and compliance obligations, and returns each finding with a severity level (high/medium/low), category, rationale, and character-offset citation back to the source text.",
      "model": "claude-opus-4.7",
      "tool_keys": [],
      "starter_messages": [
        "Analyze this agreement for unusual clauses and surface flagged terms with citations.",
        "What renewal or auto-extension terms appear in this contract?",
        "List compliance obligations and pricing-adjustment clauses in this agreement."
      ]
    }
  ]
}

Admins get a dashboard showing flag trends, reviewer workload, and vendor-level stats. Every action is recorded in an audit log, and flagged clauses can be exported as CSV.

components.role: multipart file upload with vendor selector and progress indicator during AI analysis

components.name: AgreementList
components.role: browse uploaded agreements with flag counts

components.role: shows agreement metadata and all extracted clauses + flags

components.name: AdminDashboard
components.role: flag trends chart, reviewer workload table, vendor stats

triggers.action: create users row from OIDC claims (sub, email), default role='reviewer'

parse text from in-memory file, call MGA to classify clauses with severity + citation offsets, persist agreement + clauses + flags in Postgres, embed clauses into pgvector — all before responding (file is not retained on disk)
send email notification via MGA email tool to reviewers
set resolved_by + resolved_at, write audit_log row
stream filtered flags joined with clause/agreement/vendor as CSV, write audit_log row

rules: all authenticated users (reviewers + admins) can view and act on any flag (shared worklist)
only the original uploader or an admin can delete an agreement
flag status must be one of: open, resolved, escalated, accepted
severity must be one of: high, medium, low
uploaded files are processed in memory only and never written to disk
side_effects: audit log row written on every upload, flag status change, and CSV export
email notification sent on high-severity flag creation
pgvector embeddings upserted on agreement upload

mga_assistants.name: Contract Clause Analyzer
mga_assistants.description: Analyzes uploaded vendor agreement text, extracts unusual clauses, renewal terms, pricing adjustments, and compliance obligations, and returns each finding with a severity level (high/medium/low), category, rationale, and character-offset citation back to the source text.
starter_messages: Analyze this agreement for unusual clauses and surface flagged terms with citations.
What renewal or auto-extension terms appear in this contract?
List compliance obligations and pricing-adjustment clauses in this agreement.
